news.headline:
Ravinder Heights Limited announced that Mr. Raghava Lakshmi Narasimhan has resigned from his position as Non-Executive and Independent Director of the company, effective from the close of business hours on October 03, 2026, citing age and health reasons.

Consequently, he also ceases to be a member of the company's Audit Committee and Nomination & Remuneration Committee. He confirmed that there are no other material reasons for his resignation.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Yes Bank released provisional Q2 updates, reporting Loans & Advances of 309,675 crore (up 8.6% Q-o-Q, 23.8% Y-o-Y) and Deposits of 354,084 crore (up 12.3% Q-o-Q, 19.5% Y-o-Y).

For the quarter ended 30-Sep-26, the bank recorded a CASA ratio of 30% and an LCR of 131.4%, ahead of its official Q2 financial results.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Physicswallah subsidiary FinZ Finance has entered an agreement to sell and transfer its loan portfolio aggregating to INR 95.8 crore to Auxilo Finserve. This major portfolio sale will result in a partial closure of FinZ Finance's lending operations.

The move aligns with Physicswallah's strategy to focus on core operations, optimize capital allocation, and reduce balance sheet risks by facilitating loans via third-party NBFCs. The transition is expected to conclude within the next 60 days.

Source: BSE

The EAC under MoEFCC has recommended environmental and Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) clearance for BPCL's ₹1.1 trillion greenfield refinery and petrochemical complex.

The ambitious project is being set up by Bharat Petroleum (BPCL) in Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh.

Source: Business Standard

Hawa Engineers Limited reported standalone unaudited Q2 FY2027 results, with revenue from operations declining to 2,092.8 lakh compared to 3,152.8 lakh in Q2 FY2026.

Sequentially, the company's revenue from operations also dropped from 2,373.9 lakh recorded in the preceding quarter, Q1 FY2027.

Source: Equity Bulls

news.headline:
Tata Motors has toppled Mahindra to secure the No. 2 carmaker spot in H1FY27, after Mahindra previously beat Hyundai and Tata Motors to become the second-largest carmaker in H1FY26 and FY26.

Industry sales data shows Tata sold 376,840 cars in H1FY27, outpacing Mahindra's 358,142 units by nearly 20,000 units.

Source: Financial Express

news.headline:
Axiscades Technologies announced that its German step-down subsidiary, add solution GmbH, is under voluntary solvent liquidation after several loss-making quarters. The group expects no material impact on its operations or profitability.

The subsidiary accounted for a turnover of INR 1,562.2 lakh (1.4%) and had a net worth of negative INR 1,437.2 lakh (-2%) in FY26.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
IITL Projects Limited entered into a Strategic Investment Agreement with Kaamag Private Limited and Maayin’s Real Estate Private Limited to invest up to Rs. 10 crores in an integrated residential township project in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.

The company gets 2,400 square yards of saleable area and an assured Minimum Return of Rs. 12 crores. In case of default or material breach, the investment is refundable with 16% interest per annum.

Source: BSE
